source.observed_bounds_note: Additional 20fps event sampling supports a conservative 0.10s observation interval; sample raster indices are not exact native-frame event timing. Original label is preserved separately.
direct_pixels_inspected: last visually connected neck or shaft

time_mapping.source_event_anchor_type: midpoint of direct pixel observation interval
time_mapping.mapping_limit: Semantic phase mapping, not pointwise kinematic reproduction. Entire source span is represented without loops or padding; laboratory elapsed time is not simulated time.

render.material_display: Workbench material diffuse colors with studio highlights and cavity shading; metallic node values are retained in scene but Workbench is not physically based metallic transport.

geometry.surface_detail_mechanism: authored qualitative shape, not a proven fracture mechanism

motion.upper_jaw: source-informed loading displacement, freezes at completed rupture
motion.opening_note: Complementary surfaces open progressively from front to rear under last loading displacement; no region is removed and no rigid fragment recoil is added. Gap is authored qualitative finite opening, not measured source displacement. Ductile gap/original diameter=0.446 and gap/terminal neck diameter~1.0 versus visible source postrupture ratios~0.65 and~1.3. Source ratios include source postrupture motion; here finite opening is authored during final loading to make fracture visible before selected load stop.

full_generation_configuration.saved_scene_animation: baked absolute shape keys and ordinary jaw keys; no external script required

coordinate_mapping.local_axial_stretch: 1 + uniform_stretch_at_rupture*u*gauge_taper + 4*n*exp(-(s/0.215)^2)*gauge_taper for ductile; brittle has no neck term
coordinate_mapping.axial_z: starts at -3.25, integrates local_axial_stretch over s with trapezoidal ring integration
coordinate_mapping.terminal_grip_translation: upper: total integrated axial extension + gap*q; lower: 0
coordinate_mapping.shape_key_bake: frame1, every20frames to crack onset, every crack frame, frame600; absolute shape keys with linear pose interpolation and linear time keys

encoder.input_frames: 600 numbered PNGs, no duplication or looping

observations: Source shows a smooth round reduced section clamped in opposed jaws.
Little visible uniform deformation and no pronounced plastic neck precede a transverse separation.
Source upper fixture continues moving after rupture; finite postrupture motion is not reinterpreted as zero.
authored_assumptions: Dimensionless relative geometry reconstructed from pixels; no absolute dimensions, material grade, force, strain-rate or constitutive law inferred.
Lower jaw fixed and upper jaw supplies loading; final rupture triggers immediate stop in accordance with selected DESIGN condition. This changes apparatus control relative to source.
Volume-preserving axial stretch with radius proportional to inverse square root of local axial stretch; fracture face detail is qualitative and not a proof of cup-cone or microscopic mechanism.

Fracture faces are complementary, paired interior caps until damage opens. Interface connection is judged by actual evaluated coincident vertices; Blender mesh-container separation is not used as component evidence.
Finite crack opening is created by last loading displacement while a residual interface ligament remains; no specimen section is removed, no whole-half postfracture translation or recoil is applied.
Background, apparatus detail and lighting are simplified to preserve specimen visibility.
unknowns: Exact alloy, heat treatment and strain-rate.
Absolute specimen dimensions and formal experimental gauge length.
Subframe rupture initiation and microscopic crack path.
Quantitative relation between crosshead motion, gauge extension and machine compliance.
Three-dimensional trajectory and elastic unloading in the recorded experiment.

checked_labels.result_basis: evaluated interface changes from connected to separated and encoded frame depicts fracture seam
checked_labels.failure_category_basis: source tag and distinct necked versus unnecked rendered process; independent material review remains pending
checked_labels.location_basis: inside the authored reduced-section interval [-2.55,2.55]; source formal gauge unknown, authored region is not asserted to be a standard gauge
checked_labels.anomaly_basis: fixed camera; actual shaft/jaw contact inspected and evaluated

mesh.measurement_note: Evaluated mesh positions and actual edge graph with coincident interface vertex welding at 1e-5 units; two containers do not predetermine component count. Interior paired fracture caps are hidden while interface is unbroken. Not an FEM model.

encoded_video.poststop_hash_note: Rendered raster hashes and endpoint pixel differences check visual stop, ignoring PNG metadata; H264 decoded values may vary by GOP quantization. Evaluated mesh motion is measured separately.

limits: Evaluated connectivity and volume checked at every10th frame plus all rupture-neighborhood frames and endpoint; same-material axial span and section area and all postrupture mesh positions independently measured on every one of 600 output frames after reopening saved scene. This is not a mechanical solver.
Jaw contact uses evaluated clamp face positions and actual shaft ring extrema, with measured axial embed overlap; intended specimen-jaw contact is permitted.
Corresponding fracture surface signed gaps are nonnegative; broad arbitrary-mesh collision pairs were not exhaustively tested.
Technical checks do not constitute user acceptance or material-science independent review.

same_material_and_full_frame_stop.method: Every encoded output frame independently evaluated after reopening baked .blend; same material ring stations followed, section polygon area measured from coordinates; Euclidean position change measured after completed rupture.

saved_scene.animation_note: baked absolute shape keys and ordinary jaw keys; no external script required

presentation_revision.reason: Previous elevated camera projected fracture cap surfaces over the fine real opening, making complete separation appear as a dark crease.
presentation_revision.change: Fixed camera is now level with target z=0.15, preserving azimuth; no camera motion.
presentation_revision.unchanged: Specimen geometry, fracture faces, 0.03 opening, all loading and post-stop motion, frame count and timing are unchanged.
presentation_revision.review_status: Corrected encoded frames require independent reviewer and main full-video visual inspection.

scope: 来源与原标签及归一化标签一致性
最终编码完整解码及20秒/30fps/600帧核对
视频与来源及实现或自包含场景哈希
实际网格连通性、夹口连接、事件时序、材料变化及断后停止/衰减
断裂前后密集帧画面核对

limits: 不等于用户接受、样式范围批准或训练发布

不是本构标定或微观机制证明

main_agent_view_record.scope: 实际打开最终MP4并播放破坏阶段，查看初态、加载/变形关键状态及20秒末态；结合必要抽帧检查。不是宣称逐帧人工观看600帧。
main_agent_view_record.observed: 夹具与试样均在画内；破坏事件和末态与该候选的预期标签一致；柔性断后运动有限衰减，金属及复材突断后停止。
